Meet the founder

Anurag Rishi, often called a Modern Rishi

An inner science practitioner and spiritual researcher, Anurag bridges Advaita Vedanta, the Upanishads and classical Indian healing with quantum physics, psychology and mind–body science.

His journey began with his own healing: from inner conflict to clarity, from struggle to alignment, from survival to abundance. Only after living it did he begin to teach it. He explains complex ideas through simple, everyday examples.

Advaita VedantaUpanishadsMind–body scienceSince 2007

Questions

Before you begin

Still unsure which program fits? Write to us and we will help you choose.

Where should I start if I'm new?

Start with the free Gratitude Session. If it resonates, try Mental Detox or Intentional Alignment before moving to a signature program.

Are the programs live or recorded?

Gratitude, Mental Detox, Intentional Alignment and Quantum Alignment are recorded, so you can follow them at your own pace. Awaken Your Healing Intelligence runs over 12 sessions. The Know Thyself retreat is live and residential.

Where and when is the next retreat?

Know Thyself runs 14–19 November in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand. It is a 6-day residential retreat with limited seats.

How do I pay?

Payments go through Razorpay's secure checkout. Prices shown are before tax.

Can I invite Anurag to speak at my event?

Yes. Anurag speaks at organisations, conferences and communities. Email mail@anuragrishi.com with your event details.
